lines.en: I give Tsuneyo a call just before she sets out for morning practice and wind up heading all the way across town to meet up with her so she doesn't have to walk alone.
lines.zh: 我在 Tsuneyo 出门去晨练前给她打了个电话，结果横穿整座城市去和她碰面，好让她不用一个人走。

lines.en: It's utterly horrible time management as her house is extremely far from me and she is now very likely going to be late, but hey. At least we're together.
lines.zh: 这在时间安排上简直糟透了，因为她家离我极远，而她现在很可能会迟到，不过嘿。至少我们在一起。

lines.en: The morning proceeds as normal, with cryptic dialogue and endless references to noodles, but the weather is nice enough to distract me from how {i}mostly{/i} unwanted I am.
lines.zh: 早晨照常进行，充满晦涩的对话和无尽的面条话题，不过天气够好，让我不去想自己有{i}多{/i}不受欢迎。

lines.en: There are several moments that make me think the opposite, but they're gone so quickly that I'm never able to latch on to them.
lines.zh: 有那么几个瞬间让我以为相反，可它们消失得太快，我从来抓不住。

lines.en: I think back on our trip to the amusement park and how that day was so much different from every other one we've shared.
lines.zh: 我回想起我们去游乐园的那次，那一天和我们共度的其他任何一天有多么不同。

lines.en: I'm not sure how we'll ever reach that level again if she's going to remain as aloof and dismissive as this, but it doesn't mean I can't hope.
lines.zh: 如果她继续这么冷淡疏离，我不确定我们还能不能回到那个程度，但这不代表我不能抱有希望。

lines.en: Deep down in the sodium-packed shell of hers, I know there is a girl who is dying to be both understood and accepted.
lines.zh: 在她那层钠含量超标的硬壳深处，我知道有一个极度渴望被理解、也被接纳的女孩。

lines.en: And while I can't make any promises in regard to that first part...the second is something I can't imagine I'll ever have a problem with.
lines.zh: 虽然前一部分我无法许下任何承诺……但后一部分，我无法想象自己会有任何问题。
